Consumer Units and Rewires in Norwich and Norfolk

We replace consumer units and rewire houses across Norwich and Norfolk. A consumer unit replacement is usually a 1 day job, with prices starting at £700 plus VAT.

Call 07576 485671 WhatsApp Us

How We Do It

We only use recognised brands such as Scolmore, Crabtree and JCC. We pay attention to detail throughout the work, which is why we always use known brands.

When a Consumer Unit Needs Replacing

The usual reasons we replace one are a unit that's out of date or one showing signs of damage. The pair below is one of ours: the old fuse board in a wooden box, then the new consumer unit in its place.

Full and Part Rewires

A rewire takes as long as the house needs. It depends on what you want from it and how easy it is to get at the cables, so we look first and then tell you. Recent ones include full rewires in Gressenhall and Beetley this year and a part rewire in Dereham last year.

Questions We Get Asked

Does my consumer unit need replacing?

The usual reasons are a unit that's out of date or one showing signs of damage. If you're not sure, Gary can look at yours and tell you.

How much does a consumer unit cost?

Prices start at £700 plus VAT, and it is usually a 1 day job.

Do I need a rewire?

As a general guide, rubber or fabric covered cable, round pin sockets and an old fuse box with rewirable fuses all point to old wiring. An electrical installation condition report (EICR) tells you for certain, from £120 plus VAT.

How much does a rewire cost?

It depends on the size of the house, what you need and how easy access is, so we price a rewire after a look rather than give a figure blind.
